title: Hermes Normalized Job v0
description: Output of any source adapter after extraction. NOT source-specific. Does not include any cyber classification yet — that is added by the downstream classifier.

source_job_id.description: The stable identifier from the source as captured by extraction.stable_id_path. Must be unique within (company_id, source_platform).

source_secondary_ids.description: Alternative IDs returned by the source (e.g. Eightfold's displayJobId / atsJobId, Mercedes' internal numeric ID).

organization.description: Parent org / company subsidiary name (Mercedes' ParentOrganizationName). For NVIDIA, this is implicit 'NVIDIA'.

locations.description: Normalized list of location strings. The runtime does NOT parse city/country here; that is downstream.

apply_url.description: URL that opens the actual application flow (often an external ATS).

publication_date.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) or full ISO-8601 timestamp.

expiration_date.description: ISO-8601 date or timestamp. May be absent if the source doesn't expose one.

description.description: Tasks / responsibilities text, HTML-stripped. Empty if not yet fetched.

qualifications.description: Requirements / qualifications text, HTML-stripped. Empty if not yet fetched.

language.description: Language code of the source response.

source_last_seen_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent successful harvest that observed this job.
